The '''''Interceptor''-class frigate''' was a light [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used primarily by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organizations.

==Characteristics==
The ''Interceptor'' [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was a fast and maneuverable ship and had heavy armor and powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]]. Despite the frigate being equipped with some [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers, it was lightly armed for its size.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
Though they were used by a large number of pirate groups and crime syndicates during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> including the nefarious organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="EaW" /> [[Tyber Zann]] had a large amount of these ships modified to be faster and less armored to become the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] [[Interceptor IV-class frigate|Interceptor IV frigates]].<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>
